# FleetLever

FleetLever is a web application for fleet and equipment operations.
It helps SMEs track assets, roadworthiness tests, certificates, documents, service work,
issues, operators, assignments, reports, and operational priorities.

Primary language: English (en-GB)
Category: fleet management software, equipment operations, compliance tracking
Public site: https://fleetlever.com

Key pages:
- /: Product website.
- /console: Interactive demo console.

Important product terms:
- FleetLever
- Roadworthiness
- service
- Copilot
- Import
- Export
